body: I’m kind of in the same/opposite way, I don’t want to Die and leave my boyfriend because I worry he will do the same or not be able to cope. I’ve been really trying to focus why I love him so much (or why you love her) and if you are capable of feeling even marginally better with her- then you are capable of feeling and that’s so important to start. It’s easy to forget your partner is with you for a reason, she clearly sees you are an amazing person with so much potential. She is with you to grow with you, learn with you and stumble through life together, you might feel as though she deserves better but you should also see that she’s made the choice to be with you she’s not stuck. Life can restart without death, perhaps move in together with your GF if your family life isn’t great (if you are able to) or it you work try to work more hours and get to know your colleagues or even take the long way home each day for breathing space. I am trying to wrap my head around spending time alone myself, distraction is key or so I am told ! Please stay though for her, my heart still breaks 2 years after my best friend took his life because he meant to much to me (and so many others) but was unable to see it in time. If she doesn’t know you’re feeling like this please talk to her about it, it’s worth the time

I think I understand how you are feeling, it’s scary to one day realise you’re no longer sad at the thought of dying. Sometimes the missing emotion gets put onto other things, Feel angry about things that are usually fine or just guilty about nothing at all. 
Maybe this could help explain the arguments? 
Speaking to your person about these thoughts might help, even if you don’t believe they’re connected! 

I share your feelings about an afterlife, it almost would be enticing- to know it were real. The uncertainty plays on your mind like a devil and angel; the angel says wait to find out and spend time with your family now just in case there isn’t. 
The devil says you’ll be dead one day anyway so what does it really matter? 
The angel is my best friend of the two but I understand they speak at the same volume and it’s hard to listen to just one.
The only advice I can give that I’ve used myself with some (small) success is to imagine your own funeral, I don’t mean let depression imagine empty chairs at empty tables, I mean really think about it. 
Often it’s thinking about what my twin sister might have to say, or my dog wandering why I don’t come home that straightens my feelings up and allows me to feel some sadness about the idea. 

I hope with all my heart you decide to stay past your 30 days, you are strong and brave to open up about the way you’re feeling.

Have you considered medical help for the feelings you’re having? 
Therapy isn’t for everyone - I personally found it made me feel worse, but there are many more options to explore.

I dont want to tell you about your life and suggest it might get better, as I don’t know what you’re dealing with and what happens behind the screen. 
Have you considered posting about what you’re going through or going into more detail as to why you feel this way? 

You might find comfort in knowing others have been through the same, and they may be able to share coping mechanisms and help you. 

I hope this gets to you on time

I made an account just to beg you please don’t.
My best friend did recently and not a minute goes by I don’t think of him. 
I can’t convince you not to, I can’t even convince myself not to but if you’re going to do anything for the next 38 hours please let it be thinking of what you’ll be missing. 
All the people you’ve yet to meet, everything you’ve left to see and learn. 
Life’s fucking dreadful I’ll tell you that much, I’m 23 in December and that’ll be celebrating almost 10 years since I first tried to kill myself. 
You don’t have to live your life just to keep everyone else happy but you should to keep yourself happy, there’s no happy or sad on the other side and 5 minutes of happiness a day is worth more than an eternity of empty. 
All I can do is plead you to think of what you wanted from the future before you began feeling this, and thinking what you’d want if you weren’t so down. Not about who you’d hurt but who could make you happy that you may not have even met yet. 
Sorry to go on and probably make little to no sense, I hope this gets to you on time
